item.title: Editorial: Our family is afraid to go to church
item.description: Editor Eric Black calls Texas Baptists to stand with their immigrant Christian family and provides a brief list of resources.

item.title: Celebrating Churches: Shiloh Church celebrates relocation
item.description: Shiloh Baptist Church held its first worship service at its new facility, 2525 N. Buckner Blvd., on Sunday, Feb. 1.

item.title: Texas CLC responds to racist White House post
item.description: Texas Baptists’ Christian Life Commission and other Texas Baptists’ ministry leaders condemned a racist online post depicting former President Barack Obama and former First Lady Michelle Obama.

item.title: Equip: Resources on the Books of Haggai and Malachi
item.description: Bill Bryan provides resources for the study and preaching of the short—but no less important—post-exilic prophets Haggai and Malachi.

item.title: Litzler issues challenge to uphold religious freedom
item.description: John Litzler urged Howard Payne University students to defend religious liberty and engage thoughtfully in public policy as part of the Currie-Strickland Distinguished Lectures in Christian Ethics.

item.title: Voices: Bad Bunny, belonging, and my Baptist upbringing
item.description: Chris Seay sees Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl halftime performance as a celebration of diversity the church and the nation can appreciate.

item.title: Around the State: Buckner celebrates 25th anniversary in Kenya
item.description: Buckner International celebrated the 25th anniversary of its ministry in Kenya, a joint effort with Texas and global Baptists.

item.title: Why pastors are leaving the pulpit
item.description: While only 1 percent of protestant pastors decide to step down from ministry each year, the reasons behind those decisions are dynamic.

item.title: Wiley Drake, SBC provocateur, dies at 82
item.description: Wiley Drake, a self-proclaimed “champion of the little guy” known for his perennial presence at Southern Baptist Convention annual meeting microphones, died Jan. 27. He was 82.

item.title: White Christian support for Trump falls
item.description: A new report from Pew Research found white Christians are losing confidence in President Trump’s policies.
